|802dot11_protocols = an |defaulip = |defaultlogin = ATTadmin |defaultpass = 401!VEN |defaultssid = Cisco_XXXXXXXX |defaultssid_regex = ^Cisco_[A-F0-9]{8}$ |default_ch = |manuf = Gemtek |manuf_model = WAPB-195N |manuf_rev = |is_manuf = No |tpfirmware = OpenWrt (Was) |availability = distribution via ISP |eoldate = |fccapprovdate = 02/18/2011 |estreldate = |estprice = |upc = |ean = |dx_sku = |newegg = |asin = |asin_country = |asin2 = |asin_country2 = |countrymanuf = China |buttons = |led = |dimensions = |weight = |wi1_if_name = |rad1chip1cpu = true |rad1oui = |rad1_ant_conn = U.FL |rad1txchains = 2 |rad1rxchains = 2 |rad1sstreams = 2 |rad1stand = IEEE 802.11a/n |rad1n = 300 |rad1a = 54 |rad1freq = 5 |rad1correv = |rad1cap = }}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== Designed to pair with the Cisco ISB7005 (see also [[Cisco ISB7005 Wireless Module]]). :Used by AT&T as the ''AT&T U-verse Wireless Access Point''. *"WAPB-195N_V03", "ES0-S00-5901R RoHS" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos. *"WAPB-195N_V03" and "19K-K06-8204R RoHS" is silkscreened on the board shown below. It would appear that these devices may be using either a BCM4717 or BCM4717V SoC. :There may be little (or no) difference between the two.. The default SSID appears to be '''Cisco_XXXXXXXX''' where '''XXXXXXXX''' is the last :four octets of the wireless interface MAC minus one (upper case hex letters). :An example SSID is '''Cisco_4A823669'''. The default login credentials are ATTadmin:401!VEN. :The device will, by default, request an IP via DHCP. The power adapter included with the device is an ''OEM'' ADS0128-W 120100 (12V, 1.0A). ==Links of Interest== *[http://wiki.openwrt.org/toh/cisco/ven401 On the '''OpenWrt''' Wiki] *[https://forum.openwrt.org/viewtopic.php?id=54484 On the '''OpenWrt''' forum], 'support' is noted by ''sturia'' (who provides a .trx), :however, it appears to brick (at least some) units and require recovery via CFE. *[http://www.dd-wrt.com/phpBB2/viewtopic.php?t=156413 On the '''DD-WRT''' forums] ==Flashing== {{Flashnotice}} ===Flashing OpenWrt=== {{OpenWrt |techdata = https://openwrt.org/toh/hwdata/cisco/cisco_ven401 |wikipage = https://openwrt.org/toh/cisco/ven401 |forumpage = https://forum.openwrt.org/viewtopic.php?id=54484 |github = |target = brcm47xx |subtarget = mips74k |arch = mipsel_74kc |support_commit_id = |support_started_version = 14.07 |current_supported_version = EOL |last_supported_version = 14.07 |image_too_big = |unsupportedfuncntions = |lan_hardware = |lan_comment = |wlan_hardware = Broadcom BCM4717 |wlan_comment = |usb_sata_comment = |inst_method = GUI OEM, CFE TFTP + serial recovery, see forum |inst_comment = |rec_method = |rec_comment = |comment = }} Please insert instructions here ==JTAG-Serial Info== ===Disassembly=== There are two screws holding the case together underneath the label. ===Serial=== ====Serial Pinouts====
